title: Rules this project is run by, written before any result exists

preregistration.rule: a rule's registration is the git commit that freezes it; the hash is published with the rule, and no figure computed after the hash may change the rule

registered.scope: singles-only shadow baseline for a team-strength model
registered.status: registered, not evaluated by this session

publication_contract.blank_rule: a cell with no official value is printed blank with a flag id; it is never filled by inference, never filled by a third-party value labelled as official, and never filled by a prior week's number
model_output_row: the input vector that produced it
publication_contract.market_columns: fair line / market line / difference are three separate columns; the market and difference columns stay null while DEC-P1 is open

leaderboard_rule.signal_vs_staking: signal metrics rank a strategy; staking metrics are displayed beside them and cannot promote it; ROI never appears as a ranking key
leaderboard_rule.ranked_on: benchmark-relative proper score (Brier skill) with a game-clustered lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment across trials
forbidden: any backtest figure on a leaderboard page
leaderboard_rule.reward_rule: 0 of 1,000 reward units are available until a strategy clears qualification AND verified prices exist for its graded bets

divisions.name: singles
divisions.eligibility: one market per game, forecast recorded pre-kickoff, graded on official result

divisions.name: game parlay
divisions.eligibility: blocked: joint probability not validated (see joint_evidence_gate)

divisions.name: same-game parlay
divisions.eligibility: blocked: joint probability not validated, legs share game-level dependence

divisions.name: prop combo
divisions.eligibility: blocked: no official prop prices, no operator void/push rules in the repo

joint_evidence_gate.rule: multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid under dependence; a combo may be ranked only when BOTH a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are stored for its leg set
joint_evidence_gate.current_state: 0 of 4 combo divisions eligible; 0 joint estimates with n exist in the repo; 0 operator rule sets stored

control_baselines.random_picks: computable today: a uniform pick over the two sides of each market, graded on official results
control_baselines.favorites_only: not computable today: 'favorite' is defined by a price, and no official price source exists
control_baselines.market_consensus: not computable today: one third-party archive is a capture, not a consensus
control_baselines.rule: every leaderboard run must show the random baseline beside it, and must state which baselines are unavailable and why

components_live.name: opponent-strength adjustment
components_live.input: official standings PF/PA over 145 credited games; identity check sum(PF)=sum(PA)=6664

components_live.name: league base rates
components_live.input: official W-L-T for 32 clubs; ties handled explicitly (NYG and WAS 1 tie each)

components_blocked.name: realised ROI vs stake
components_blocked.blocked_by: DEC-P1 price policy, and by the ban on ROI as a ranking

removal_of_luck_panel.presentation: the panel states '2 of 4 live' on its face; a blocked component is not replaced by a proxy without a written definition

demotion_gate.rule: any LIVE strategy returns to PAPER automatically on any of: (1) the 20-game rolling Brier-skill lower bound falls at or below 0; (2) a data-integrity failure in its inputs for 2 consecutive weeks; (3) its pre-registered refute condition fires; (4) its source page changes schema and the parser is not re-verified within 7 days
demotion_gate.current_evaluation: 0 strategies are LIVE, so the gate has nothing to demote; it is published so that the first promotion cannot be its own exception
demotion_gate.on_demotion: the strategy keeps its history, loses its board rank, and its reward accrual stops at the moment of demotion, not at the moment of review

price_data_policy.decision_needed: what counts as a market price for the purpose of a residual, a CLV measure and a reward
price_data_policy.interim_rule: no backtest that quotes a market number may be published on this namespace's pages until the decision is recorded; a model-only residual (fair line vs official final margin) is allowed and is labelled as not a price residual

ablation_spec.status: frozen for a future run; not executed, because the input does not exist yet
arms: A: team-strength model, availability features removed
B: identical model, availability features included
ablation_spec.data_join: dated availability capture per club per week joined to official results; only weeks with >=2 dated captures count
ablation_spec.eval: chronological holdout by week; no shuffling across weeks; graded with a proper score
ablation_spec.uncertainty: game-cluster bootstrap over weeks, reported as an interval, never as a point
ablation_spec.forbidden: a fixed point penalty per missing starter, and any penalty weight chosen after seeing results

depth_rule.rule: depth rank is never inferred from jersey number, seniority, salary, or an image read by eye; a rank may only be stored when a source publishes it as a dated, structured value
depth_rule.slot_rule: a depth slot is a set of players, not a starter; multiple players sharing a rank, sharing one slot, or leaving a slot empty are all published as such
depth_rule.open_source_question: Q-05 (no authorized structured rank source exists today)
depth_rule.note_on_this_session: no player in this namespace is described as a starter, a backup, or a rank - the capture publishes designations only, because that is all the official report publishes

correlation_policy.inputs: officially sourced numbers only (scores, standings, report counts); third-party captures are excluded from every r published here
correlation_policy.reporting: n, r, and the derivation script path on the same row; an r without n is not published
correlation_policy.lookahead: a correlation between two variables measured from the same single week is labelled 'descriptive, n=1 week' and may not be used as a model input

capture_cadence.target: daily Wed -> kickoff per game week, one dated entry per read, with a hash of the stored transcription
capture_cadence.actual: 1 dated capture by this session (2026-11-15); 5 peer captures exist at the base commit
capture_cadence.limitation: no scheduler runs; the cadence is manual until SUG-02 A is chosen
capture_cadence.clock_convention: reads are recorded with a window and an order index; the harness gives no per-call clock, so minute-level precision is not claimed

data_layer.public: derived analysis: counts, coverage, indices, gates, registers, and links to the official page
data_layer.private_pending: row-level captures at volume; today the one 347-row capture is published on the public page because the brief asks for all entries in table form - Q-16 keeps the terms question open and SUG-09 records what changes if the answer is no

splits.available: one season of official results (2026) + 2025 standings as a pre-season prior
splits.rule: until a second full season is stored, every published comparison is chronological-by-week within one season, and no 'holdout season' claim may be made
